title: What Voss Found Out
notebook: Voss asks directly whether I gave the framework documentation to Orythia. He is standing, waiting.
He built the engine over eleven years. He found out about the Orythian deal himself.
dialogue: Voss requested the meeting himself. He has never done that before.
monologue: He found out about the Orythian deal. I do not know how. With Voss I am never sure whether the answer is that he is more observant than he appears or that I was less careful than I believed.

narrative.text: You gave them the framework documentation. I need to know if that is true.
He is standing. He has not sat. He is holding the satchel with both hands and he is standing and waiting for an answer.

voss_betrayal_scene.monologue: He is standing and waiting. He built it for eleven years and he is standing in my office waiting for me to tell him whether I gave it away. I owe him the truth. I am deciding whether I have the courage for it.

choices.text: "Yes. A controlled subset to Orythia. I should have told you."
"The licensing arrangements are classified. I cannot discuss the specifics."
